description:
Activate Casey & Raph by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Casey & Raph enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Casey & Raph.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
